seeded-a's default pool moves from e2-medium to e2-standard-2 for CPU headroom (main.tf, the pool's machine_type comment): node_config.machine_type is ForceNew, so the change is a delete and a create on every project; one-shot, removed by a follow-up once every project's reconcile reports it unused
